related.title: ITER 國際磁約束研究工程
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對球形幾何、診斷及可擴充物理；ITER 國際磁約束研究工程改以大型 tokamak 系統、低溫磁體與熱排出為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on spherical geometry, diagnostics and scalable physics; ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering centers on large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照低aspect ratio約束與tokamak真空與磁場，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到ITER 國際磁約束研究工程，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以研究結果外推邊界為起點，設計一項能區分「球形幾何、診斷及可擴充物理」與「大型 tokamak 系統、低溫磁體與熱排出」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare low-aspect-ratio confinement with tokamak vacuum/magnetic fields and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from research extrapolation boundaries and propose an observation distinguishing spherical geometry, diagnostics and scalable physics from large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust, including uncertainty.

related.title: Wendelstein 7-X 三維仿星器
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對球形幾何、診斷及可擴充物理；Wendelstein 7-X 三維仿星器改以非平面超導線圈與長脈衝熱管理為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on spherical geometry, diagnostics and scalable physics; Wendelstein 7-X three-dimensional stellarator centers on nonplanar superconducting coils and long-pulse heat management, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照低aspect ratio約束與三維stellarator約束，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Wendelstein 7-X 三維仿星器，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以研究結果外推邊界為起點，設計一項能區分「球形幾何、診斷及可擴充物理」與「非平面超導線圈與長脈衝熱管理」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare low-aspect-ratio confinement with 3d stellarator confinement and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Wendelstein 7-X three-dimensional stellarator, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from research extrapolation boundaries and propose an observation distinguishing spherical geometry, diagnostics and scalable physics from nonplanar superconducting coils and long-pulse heat management, including uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: NSTX-U 球形電漿研究
history.text: NSTX-U 球形電漿研究的公開資料展示球形幾何、診斷及可擴充物理的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for NSTX-U spherical-plasma research illustrate spherical geometry, diagnostics and scalable physics. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型
history.titleEn: From engineering story to reviewable models
history.text: 本課將球形幾何、診斷及可擴充物理改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns spherical geometry, diagnostics and scalable physics into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
